features: PM1's 10 columns (type L, type M, air, process, difference, speed, torque, power, tool wear, wear x torque)

smote.space: raw columns, continuous ones standardised with training statistics

threshold_rule: PM1 cost_threshold on validation: minimise 2000 x missed + 150 x alerts

adversarial.predictor: nn.Linear(10, 1) on standardised features, balanced class weights, L2 as scikit-learn C=1
adversarial.adversary: nn.Linear(3, 3) on [s, s*y, s*(1-y)], s = sigmoid((1+|c|) logit)
adversarial.probe: multinomial logistic on [z, z*y, y], fitted on validation, scored on test

command: uv run --with scikit-learn==1.7.2 --with imbalanced-learn==0.14.0 python evaluations/imbalance_study.py
